official_sources.title: Chapter 2.6 — Fish and Fish Products, Version 2 (04.11.2024)
View all FSSAI Standardized Food Products

common_rules.text: Food additives are permitted only where allowed by the relevant Chapter 2.6 standard and Appendix A. Frozen squid under clause 2.6.1(3) explicitly permits no food additive.
Fish and fish products shall comply with the applicable microbiological requirements in Appendix B where referenced by the product standard.
Applicable fish and fish products shall comply with the Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Regulations.
Applicable products shall be prepared and handled in accordance with Schedule 4 licensing/registration hygiene requirements and other applicable FSSAI guidance.

The Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 apply in addition to product-specific declarations. Older consolidated text may still contain historical references to the former Packaging and Labelling Regulations.

superseded_standards.name: Sardine Oil
superseded_standards.note: The current consolidated Chapter 2.6 displays the older Sardine Oil provision followed by an amendment substituting the current Fish Oil standard.

cross_cutting_rules.name: Limit of Naturally Occurring Formaldehyde

limits.group: Group I — Marine finfish, elasmobranchs, crustaceans and molluscs except Group III & IV
Group III — Lizard fishes and other marine fishes not covered under Group I
Group IV — Frozen stored marine fish products

cross_cutting_rules.source_note: The current consolidated table prints the Group II freshwater-origin row without a numeric value in the visible limit cell. PMSV therefore does not hard-code a Group II limit from inference; it remains pending source clarification before machine validation.
cross_cutting_rules.additional_rule: For fish and fish products of marine origin other than those covered by the specified table groups, the chapter states a maximum naturally occurring formaldehyde limit of 100 ppm.

standards.name: Frozen Shrimp
standards.definition: Frozen raw, partially cooked or fully cooked shrimp/prawn, peeled or unpeeled, from the listed shrimp families.
process_rules: Use potable-quality water or clean seawater meeting equivalent microbiological standards for cooking/glazing.
Keep deep frozen during transportation, storage and distribution and minimise dehydration and oxidation.
label_rules: Where applicable, frozen storage at -18°C or lower is to be displayed.

standards.name: Frozen Lobsters
standards.definition: Frozen raw or cooked lobster from Homarus/Nephropidae, Palinuridae, Scyllaridae and Norway lobster as specified; product shall not be a mixture of different species.

standards.name: Frozen Squid and Parts of Squid
standards.definition: Frozen product prepared from sound fresh squid of the specified squid families; may be glazed with water.

standards.name: Frozen Finfish
standards.definition: Finfish suitable for human consumption, with or without head and with viscera/organs completely or partially removed.

composition.parameter: Histamine in raw material for listed susceptible fish families

label_rules: Frozen storage at -18°C or lower to be displayed.

standards.name: Frozen Fish Fillets
standards.definition: Slices removed from fish carcass by cuts parallel to the backbone; sections may be cut to facilitate packing/further processing.

composition.parameter: Histamine in raw material for listed susceptible fish families

label_rules: Frozen storage at -18°C or lower to be displayed.

standards.name: Salted Fish / Dried Salted Fish
standards.definition: Dried or salted-and-dried fishery product prepared from fresh or wholesome fish after drying with or without addition of salt.

composition.parameter: Salt content as sodium chloride — dry salted fishery products
Histamine — applicable listed histamine-forming fish species
Acid insoluble ash on dry basis

standards.name: Canned Fishery Products
standards.definition: Canned finfish, crustaceans or molluscs solid-packed or packed in oil, water or another suitable medium.

composition.parameter: Sodium chloride in brine-treated sardine and mackerel
Brine acidity as anhydrous citric acid

packaging_rules: Cans shall be suitable, hermetically sealed, free from rust and appropriately lacquered.

standards.name: Frozen Cephalopods
standards.definition: Raw frozen cephalopods or parts of cephalopods from the specified families.
label_rules: Frozen storage at -18°C or lower to be displayed.

standards.name: Smoked Fishery Products
process_rules: Smoking material shall not contain toxic substances from natural origin, contamination, chemicals, paint or impregnation treatment.
Smoking shall minimise formation of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons.
label_rules: Declare product-appropriate storage and handling instructions.

standards.name: Ready-to-Eat Finfish or Shell Fish Curry in Retortable Pouches
standards.definition: Thermally processed instant finfish or shellfish curry hermetically sealed in retortable pouches and processed to commercial sterility.

composition.parameter: Disintegrated fish portion on drained-mass basis

process_rules.parameter: Retort F0 at slowest heating point

standards.microbiology: Thermally processed fishery-product requirements in Appendix B

standards.name: Fish Oil
product_family: named fish oils — Anchovy, Tuna, Krill, Menhaden and Salmon
named fish liver oil — Cod liver oil
highly concentrated fish oil ethyl esters

formulation_rules.parameter: EPA + DHA — highly concentrated fish oil
EPA + DHA — concentrated fish-oil ethyl esters
EPA + DHA — highly concentrated fish-oil ethyl esters
Trans fatty acids in refined fish oils, excluding specified vaccenic/linolelaidic exclusions

quality_parameters.parameter: Acid value — oils with phospholipid concentration >=30%, e.g. krill oil

specific_rules.parameter: EPA + DHA — Anchovy oil from Engraulis ringens

label_rules: Declare species for named fish/fish-liver oils and their crude forms.
Declare whether salmon oil is from wild-caught or farm-raised salmon.
Declare Vitamin A and D content in fish liver oils.
Declare EPA and DHA content on all fish oils and fish liver oils.
standards.effective_note: The substituted Fish Oil amendment in the current Chapter 2.6 states that it came into force on 1 May 2025.

standards.name: Edible Fish Powder
standards.definition: Fine powder prepared from non-oily white fish such as sprats, from a single species or mixture, intended for food use.
prohibited_or_absent: Organic solvents or chemicals in preparation

composition.parameter: Acid insoluble ash on dry basis

standards.name: Fish Pickles
prohibited_or_absent: Firming agents other than common salt and vinegar

composition.parameter: Acidity as acetic acid of fluid portion

process_rules.parameter: Fish temperature before transport to freezing factory

standards.name: Frozen Clam Meat
quality_rules: Soft and firm texture; reasonably uniform size; free from discoloration, deterioration, sand, shell pieces, filth and other foreign matter.

standards.name: Live and Raw Bivalve Molluscs
scope: processed raw bivalves retaining sensory characteristics
quality_rules: Live bivalves shall be harvested from approved/classified areas and retain freshness response to percussion.
A live-bivalve sample unit is defective if dead or damaged molluscs exceed 5% by count.
exclusions: Scallops where the final product is adductor muscle only are covered by the separate scallop standard.
label_rules: Specify storage conditions/temperature needed to maintain safety or viability.

standards.name: Sturgeon Caviar
standards.definition: Granular caviar made from eggs of Acipenseridae-family sturgeons treated with food-grade salt.

standards.name: Fish Sauce
standards.definition: Translucent, non-turbid liquid obtained by fermentation of fish and salt; does not apply to fish sauce produced by acid hydrolysis.

composition.parameter: pH when fermentation-assisting ingredients are used

quality_rules: Translucent, not turbid, free from sediment other than salt crystals, characteristic odour/taste and free from foreign matter.

standards.name: Quick Frozen Fish Sticks (Fish Fingers), Fish Portions and Fish Fillets — Breaded or Battered
standards.definition: Quick-frozen breaded or battered fish sticks/fingers, portions and fillets prepared from fish fillets, minced fish flesh or mixtures thereof.
label_rules: Storage at -18°C or lower to be declared.
quality_rules: Boneless-designated packs are subject to the bone-defect criteria specified in the standard.

standards.name: Fresh and Quick Frozen Raw Scallop Products
variants: Fresh or Quick Frozen Scallop Meat
Fresh or Quick Frozen Roe-on Scallop Meat
Quick Frozen Scallop/Roe-on Scallop Meat with added water and/or water/phosphate solution
ingredient_rules: Plain scallop meat/roe-on scallop meat contains no added water, phosphates or other ingredients.
Added water and/or water-phosphate solution and optionally salt are allowed only for the designated added-water/phosphate presentation and uptake must be measured and labelled.
quality_rules: Deep dehydration affecting greater than 10% of weight or block surface is a defined defect.

standards.name: Pasteurized Fish Sausage
standards.definition: Fish-mince or surimi-based emulsion product with seasoning/spices/additives, stuffed in suitable casing and heat processed to achieve pasteurisation.
standards.microbiology: Convenience Fishery Products — Item 15 of Appendix B fish/fishery-product microbiological requirements
label_rules: Pack in transparent food-grade containers and provide best-before information.

standards.name: Pasteurised Crab Meat
standards.definition: Cooked, pasteurised and chilled crab meat intended for direct consumption with or without cooking, or further processing.

composition.unit: % of water capacity, minus necessary GMP headspace

standards.microbiology: Convenience Fishery Products — Item 15 / applicable Appendix B requirement
packaging_rules: Pack in appropriate hermetically sealed containers.

standards.name: Gelatin from Fish Processing Waste
standards.definition: Gelatin derived from collagen-rich fish-processing waste such as skin, bones, swim bladder and scales.
standards.microbiology: Convenience Fishery Products — Item 15 of Appendix B fish/fishery-product microbiological requirements
